objective: Red-team the source CI/CD pipeline and close the highest-value remaining release supply-chain gap with reproducible, non-sensitive evidence.
scope: GitHub Actions source workflows and job dependency gates
release SBOM vulnerability analysis and evidence retention
contract tests and framework-mapped red-team report
out_of_scope: GitOps repository and live CD inspection owned by the parent task
deployment, release publication, secrets, Vault, and validator key material
success_criteria: Release candidates fail closed on actionable SBOM vulnerabilities
The scan consumes the exact SBOM produced for the release artifact
Only compact non-sensitive scan evidence is retained
Workflow graph and implementation contracts pass locally
escalation_trigger: Any deployment, publish, merge, secret access, or production mutation returns to the primary task owner.
